dag_infos.description: New Taipei Youth Bureau A05-A08 program statistics. The ETL keeps source age bands only; A05 can be apportioned to 18-35 at query time, while A06-A08 have unavailable participant age.

data_infos.name_cn: 新北市青年局 A05-A08 青年服務、青創課程及綜合發展補助統計
data_infos.source_type: 新北市政府青年局 PDF 統計分析報告
data_infos.dataset_description: A05 113 年青職基地職涯服務、A06 114 年青創小聚（另含 115 年 1-6 月）、A07 113 年綜合發展補助性別統計、A08 112 年綜合發展補助統計。來源均無行政區欄位，固定為新北市全市 area_code=65000。
data_infos.etl_description: Fetch every official PDF with a browser User-Agent, require a PDF magic header and a text layer, then parse semantic sections with Poppler pdftotext -layout. Parse A05 age labels to integer intervals without age inference. Keep A06-A08 participant age bounds null because the reports do not provide participant age. Validate each source section against its reported totals; omit A08 applicant-type subsection because 86+10+12=108 conflicts with the reported 111 cases. Apply a three-times-median scale guard to each comparable series. A05 18-35 handling is query-stage apportionment only; no 18-35 result is materialized.
